steps.why: api and ui import @lumen/common through its dist/ output (main/types/exports point at ./dist), so typecheck needs common built first. This is the repo's own workspace build; the root build script runs it too.
Build @lumen/common to dist, since api and ui import its types and JS from dist.
The ui project references the api project and needs its declaration output (api/dist/src/routes/index.d.ts) for the Hono client types. Without it ui typecheck fails with TS6305.
